name: identity_mass_desynchronization
label: Echoes of the Unbound Self
godotFeature: CharacterBody3D/RigidBody3D properties (mass, friction, gravity_scale) and custom physics calculations via _physics_process
poeticVision: The player will feel the profound instability of a crumbling self. As Lyra loses memories, her very physical presence wavers; her mass fluctuates, making her movements unpredictable. A lost memory might cause her to become unnervingly light, sending her careening with unexpected force from minor impacts, or making it impossible to gain purchase on slippery surfaces. Conversely, recovering a memory temporarily grounds her, restoring a sense of physical coherence and stability. This constant re-calibration of her own body's physics forces the player into a desperate, adaptive struggle, where the grief of self-loss is not just emotional but viscerally physical.
usage: Attach this script to Lyra's CharacterBody3D node. The 'identity_integrity' property will dynamically adjust her physical responsiveness. Call 'lose_memory(amount)' when Lyra loses a memory fragment (e.g., due to damage or failing a challenge). Call 'recover_memory(amount)' when Lyra successfully retrieves a memory fragment; this will also grant a temporary physical stability boost. Use 'apply_external_force(force_vector)' to simulate knockback or environmental pushes, which will be more pronounced when Lyra's identity integrity is low.

parameters.name: identity_integrity
parameters.description: Current state of Lyra's identity, ranging from 0.0 (no self) to 1.0 (full self). This value directly influences her physical properties like mass resistance and friction.

parameters.name: BASE_MOVEMENT_SPEED
parameters.description: The base maximum speed Lyra can achieve when moving.

parameters.name: BASE_ACCELERATION_RATE
parameters.description: The base rate at which Lyra accelerates to her maximum movement speed.

parameters.name: BASE_DECELERATION_RATE
parameters.description: The base rate at which Lyra decelerates when no movement input is given, simulating friction.

parameters.name: MIN_MASS_RESISTANCE_FACTOR
parameters.description: The minimum multiplier for Lyra's resistance to changes in velocity. A lower value makes her feel 'lighter' and more susceptible to external forces and less responsive to input.

parameters.name: MAX_MASS_RESISTANCE_FACTOR
parameters.description: The maximum (normal) multiplier for Lyra's resistance to changes in velocity.

parameters.name: MIN_FRICTION_COEFFICIENT
parameters.description: The minimum multiplier for Lyra's effective friction. A lower value makes her feel 'slippery' and harder to stop or change direction.

parameters.name: MAX_FRICTION_COEFFICIENT
parameters.description: The maximum (normal) multiplier for Lyra's effective friction.

parameters.name: RECOVERY_BOOST_STRENGTH
parameters.description: An additional strength multiplier applied to mass resistance and friction coefficients during the temporary boost after recovering a memory.

parameters.name: RECOVERY_BOOST_DURATION
parameters.description: The duration in seconds for the temporary physical stability boost granted after Lyra recovers a memory.

verdict: The self unravels not just in mind, but in the very fabric of being, forcing a desperate dance with a body that forgets its own weight.
impact: This mechanic will fundamentally alter the player's interaction with the game world, transforming the abstract concept of identity loss into a visceral, ever-changing physical challenge. Players will constantly adapt to Lyra's fluctuating mass and friction, making every movement, jump, and combat encounter unpredictable and demanding. The grief of self-loss will be felt not just emotionally, but through the very instability of their character's body, creating a deeply immersive and unforgettable struggle for control and coherence.
